programs.name: nostd_minimal
programs.description: Zero-libc `#![no_std]` custom `_start` binary reading stack `argc`/`argv`/`envp`, growing `brk`, copying `stdin`->`stdout`, writing `stderr`, and calling `exit_group`.

programs.name: exit_codes
programs.description: Rust `std` (`#![no_main]` + static musl `__libc_start_main`) returning exit codes `0`, `1`, `2`, `42`, and `255`.

programs.name: echo_cat
programs.description: Rust `std` (`io::stdin().read_to_end` -> `io::stdout().write_all`) streaming empty, binary, and multi-page inputs.

programs.name: word_count
programs.description: Rust `std` line/word/byte counter formatting counts via `writeln!` to `stdout`.

programs.name: argv_envp
programs.description: Rust `std` inspector printing `argc`, `argv[0..argc]`, `envc`, and musl `environ[0..envc]`.

programs.name: arith_sort
programs.description: Rust `std` `i64`/`i128` arithmetic, `slice::sort`, FNV-1a digest, and malformed-input `stderr` error path (`exit 2`).

programs.name: btreemap_vec
programs.description: Hashbrown-free `BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>` insert/remove/range workload over `SYS_brk` plus 32 KiB `SYS_mmap` + `SYS_munmap` scratch buffer.

programs.name: stderr_stdio
programs.description: Interleaved `io::stdout()` (`fd 1`) and `io::stderr()` (`fd 2`) writes with `exit 0` and `exit 1` modes.

programs.name: getrandom_use
programs.description: `SYS_getrandom` (`278`) conformance checker (`0`, `GRND_NONBLOCK`, `-EINVAL`, `-EFAULT`) plus live/oracle 16-byte hex dump mode.

programs.name: session_store
programs.description: Stateful pre-key session protocol CLI (`keygen`/`init`/`send`/`recv`) with atomic `BTreeMap` directory stores, `coins` randomness file, `0`-byte pre-key deletion, and VFS edge-case probes.

programs.name: std_startup_probe
programs.description: Full Rust `fn main()` (`std::rt::lang_start`) binary capturing every startup/teardown syscall emitted before and after `main`.

programs.name: unmodified_std_probe
programs.description: Zero-shim `#![no_main]` `std` binary probing stock `std::fs` (`fcntl`), stock musl `mallocng` (`mmap PROT_NONE`), `panic!`, `abort()`, `udf #0`, `brk #1`, and `brk #0`.

programs.name: base64_codec
programs.description: RFC 4648 base64 encoder (76-column wrapping) and whitespace-tolerant decoder reporting the offset of invalid symbols, misplaced padding, or truncated quanta (`exit 1`).

programs.name: hexdump
programs.description: `hexdump -C` canonical formatter (offset, two 8-byte hex groups, `|ascii|` gutter) with `*` squeezing of repeated rows and `-v` to disable it.

programs.name: sha256sum
programs.description: Crate-free FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 of `stdin` (`<hex>  -`) plus `-c <hex>` verification mode (`OK` / `FAILED` with `exit 1`).

programs.name: rle_codec
programs.description: Byte-level `(count, byte)` run-length compressor/decompressor with corrupt-stream detection (`exit 1`) and an in-memory roundtrip self-check mode.

programs.name: sort_uniq
programs.description: `sort | uniq -c` emulation over `stdin` lines via `slice::sort_unstable`, with `-r` (reverse), `-n` (by count), and `-d` (duplicates only).

programs.name: grep_lite
programs.description: Fixed-string `grep` over `stdin` with `-i`/`-v`/`-n`/`-c` flags and POSIX exit status (`0` match, `1` no match, `2` usage).

programs.name: rpn_calc
programs.description: Per-line reverse-Polish `i64` calculator with checked arithmetic and stack operations, reporting underflow, division by zero, overflow, or unknown tokens on `stderr` (`exit 1`).

programs.name: file_copy
programs.description: Stock `std::fs` file copy / ASCII-uppercase transform with `File::open` read-back verification, and a multi-file `cat` mode reporting `ENOENT` (`exit 1`).

programs.name: json_lint
programs.description: Non-recursive JSON tokenizer and bracket matcher validating escapes, numbers, and literals, printing token-class counts and max depth or the first error offset (`exit 1`).

programs.name: bignum
programs.description: Base-`10^9` arbitrary-precision factorial, Fibonacci, and power-of-two printer with digit count and digit sum.

programs.name: matrix_mul
programs.description: Deterministic LCG-seeded `N x N` `i64` matrix multiply with trace, FNV-1a checksum, first row, and `A * I == A` self-check.

programs.name: env_lookup
programs.description: `std::env::var_os` (musl `getenv`) lookups over the initial environment (`exit 1` if any name is unset) and a sorted raw-`environ` listing mode.

programs.name: rot_cipher
programs.description: ROT13, signed Caesar shift, and Atbash substitution of `stdin` selected by `argv`, plus a letter-frequency histogram mode.

programs.name: collatz_stats
programs.description: Collatz chain statistics over an `argv` range: longest chain, highest peak with `u64` overflow checks, total and median length, and a `BTreeMap` histogram.

expected_lean.notes: `std::process::abort()` calls musl `abort()` -> `raise(SIGABRT)` -> `rt_sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, &app_mask, ...)` (`135`), which fails closed with `.Exception` on non-zero signal masks.

`asm!("udf #0")` (`0x00000000`, emitted by `core::intrinsics::abort`) raises `SIGILL` (`signal = 4`) on Linux/QEMU, whereas `Decode.lean` maps `0x00000000` to `none` -> `.Halted` (`out? = none`, distinct from `.Exception "udf"`).
`asm!("udf #1")` (`0x00000001`, non-zero `UDF #imm16`) raises `SIGILL` (`signal = 4`) on Linux/QEMU and decodes to `.udf 1` -> fail-closed `.Exception "udf"` in Lean.

ISA/Process divergence: `asm!("brk #1")` terminates abnormally with `SIGTRAP` (`signal = 5`) on Linux/QEMU, whereas `Eval.lean` transitions `BRK #1` to `.Exited 101#64` (treated by `runElf` / `ProcessExitsWith` as clean exit code `101`).
`asm!("brk #0")` terminates with `SIGTRAP` (`signal = 5`) on Linux/QEMU and transitions to `.Halted` (`out? = none`, distinct from `.Exception`) in Lean.
